title: Ensemble-Based Reconstruction and Prioritization of Binding Sites in Influenza A Nucleoprotein.
authors: Qi, Xinyu; Rahali, Ines Sabine; Munier, Sandie; Badel, Anne; Flatters, Delphine; Camproux, Anne-Claude
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文基于分子动力学模拟的流感核蛋白构象系综重建并优先排序动态结合口袋，属于蛋白质构象采样与结合位点计算分析，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
abstract: Influenza A nucleoprotein (NP) is essential for viral RNA binding, ribonucleoprotein assembly, and NP oligomerization, making it an attractive antiviral target; however, static structures incompletely capture the conformational variability governing pocket formation and accessibility. Here, 17,178 pockets detected across 753 monomeric NP conformations from three independent molecular dynamics simulations were grouped by pocket-lining residue composition to reconstruct recurrent binding-site regions. Six potentially druggable sites were retained and characterized according to their recurrence, residue-level organization, conformational plasticity, and assembly context, revealing three compact, residue-stable sites, two adaptive RNA-proximal regions, and an extended E339-centered interdomain groove. Four sites corresponded to experimentally characterized or structurally supported ligand-binding environments, while assembly mapping revealed context-dependent exposure near RNA- and NP-NP interaction surfaces, thereby identifying dynamic NP binding-site regions prioritized for ligand-specific investigation and distinguishing stable pockets from plastic regions whose organization and accessibility depend on conformational and assembly context.
abstract_zh: 甲型流感核蛋白（NP）对于病毒RNA结合、核糖核蛋白组装及NP寡聚化至关重要，使其成为有吸引力的抗病毒靶点；然而，静态结构无法完全捕捉控制口袋形成和可及性的构象变异性。在此，从三个独立分子动力学模拟中检测到的753个单体NP构象中识别出的17,178个口袋，根据口袋内衬残基组成进行分组，以重建反复出现的结合位点区域。保留了六个潜在可成药位点，并根据其重现性、残基水平组织、构象可塑性和组装背景进行表征，揭示出三个紧凑且残基稳定的位点、两个适应性RNA邻近区域，以及一个以E339为中心的延伸结构域间沟槽。四个位点对应于实验表征或结构支持的配体结合环境，而组装图谱揭示了RNA和NP-NP相互作用表面附近的背景依赖性暴露，从而识别出优先用于配体特异性研究的动态NP结合位点区域，并区分稳定口袋与可塑区域，后者的组织和可及性取决于构象和组装背景。
